title: A Game on the Kitchen Table
story: Every Tuesday evening, Imani set a chessboard on the kitchen table. Her uncle Theo was teaching her the pieces. She already knew the pawns moved one square, but the knights still confused her. Theo showed the L shape with two coins and a bean. Imani tried the move and captured his bishop. She grinned, then saw that her queen was in danger. Theo did not let her take the move back. He said a real game had no second chances. They played until the soup was ready. Imani wrote the knight move on a card and taped it inside the box. Next week she wanted to remember it without help.
